Google._comment: From Google Cloud Console > APIs & Services > Credentials. ClientId is also the audience for ID token validation.

Apple._comment: ClientId = Service ID from Apple Developer (e.g. co.za.aptiverse.web). Used as the expected audience when validating Apple ID tokens server-side.

EmailSettings._comment: AWS SES SMTP in eu-west-1 (af-south-1 has NO SES SMTP endpoint, see infra/terraform/ses). Username/Password are SES SMTP credentials (IAM access key id + region-derived password), injected via EmailSettings__Username/Password env vars in dev (.env) and prod, NOT committed here.
